The season ran from 2 March to 2 November 2008. [[G.D. Interclube|Interclube]] were the defending champions. The league comprised 14 teams and the bottom three were relegated to the 2009 [[Gira Angola]]. [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Petro Atlético de Luanda]] were crowned champions,{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2008/9/43/Petro-Luanda-win-national-championship,44a8fb33-cb80-4d1d-b523-f46656503363.html |title=Petro de Luanda win national championship |publisher=ANGOP.com |date= 26 Oct 2008 |access-date= 5 Dec 2014}} while [[S.L. Benfica (Lubango)|Benfica do Lubango]], [[Atlético Petróleos do Huambo|Petro do Huambo]] and [[G.D. Sagrada Esperança|Sagrada Esperança]] were relegated. [[José Carlos da Silva Santana|Santana Carlos]] of [[Atlético Petróleos Luanda|Petro Luanda]] finished as top scorer with 20 goals.{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2008/10/45/Petro-Luanda-Santana-2008-season-best-scorer,3dc46aa4-e3d4-426a-a246-460a21de9279.html |title=Petro de Luanda's Santana 2008 season best scorer |publisher=ANGOP.com |date=3 Nov 2008 |access-date= 7 Sep 2015}} ==FAF penalties== On its official weekly report 0032/SG/08, [[F.C.
